name: Teamwork
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Teamwork, plan client projects, log time, manage milestones, and expose a client view. The hard boundary is agency billing, workload, client permissions, integrations, and reporting, plus collaboration, integrations, and organizational trust.
